contexts.text: A fictional neighbourhood survey asked residents about evening activities. The results showed a growing trend towards using the local sports hall. An expert helped the group check how the responses had been recorded. She explained that a combination of factors might account for the change: a new bus service, longer opening hours and cheaper classes. The group was willing to ask more questions before drawing conclusions. It did not assume that one age group had changed its behaviour for only one reason. Clear records helped everyone discuss the evidence calmly.
